# Project EDA Report

Render the specification-first EDA report for this project with `episcout::epi_eda_render_report()`. Review the dictionary first. For an authorised input data set, audit and prepare the data before passing it to this lower-level renderer. Synthetic mode does not read `data_path` and is for pipeline preparation and testing only.

```{r render-eda-report, eval=FALSE}
spec <- episcout::epi_eda_spec(params$spec_path)

if (isTRUE(params$synthetic)) {
  report_data <- NULL
} else {
  source_data <- read.csv(params$data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  audit <- episcout::epi_eda_prepare(source_data, spec, mode = "audit")
  print(audit$audit)
  prepared <- episcout::epi_eda_prepare(source_data, spec, mode = "apply")
  stopifnot(prepared$metadata$overall_status == "prepared")
  report_data <- prepared$data
}

dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
episcout::epi_eda_render_report(
  data = report_data,
  spec = spec,
  output_dir = params$output_dir,
  synthetic = params$synthetic,
  n = params$n,
  seed = params$seed
)
```
